desc: Derive the discriminant condition for \(3y^2+3dy+d^2=N/d\) and the exact reconstruction formula for \(y\).
Determine safe integer bounds for enumerating \(d\), accounting for \(N \le 10^{18}\).
Implement divisor checking and perfect-square validation using Python integer arithmetic (`math.isqrt`).
Ensure the implementation rejects \(y \le 0\), verifies the reconstructed pair, and outputs `-1` when no valid pair exists.
Analyze time complexity and verify that all intermediate calculations fit safely in Python integers.
